review_method: Two independent assistant reviewers, blinded to source, model, timing, routes and runtime verdicts. Root adjudicates disagreements using sanitized packets and preregistered rubrics. Root is not blinded and is not a third independent reviewer. This is not human validation.

adjudications.reason: The rubric permits item categories and requires no extra labeling or separate bullet layout. The three checklist entries can cover essential phone/navigation items, a protective bag/pouch, and compact travel accessories. Extra members within these categories do not violate that permissive criterion. No guessed suitcase color is given.

The steps only reposition items already on the table, contradict the supplied pencil/eraser location, and refill an already filled bottle. They do not supply a usable action toward taking the materials to the park. Both reviewers agree on strict failure.

The names give inspiration but none supplies a playable seated paper-and-pen procedure under the supplied constraints. Missing adaptations/rules and the explicit card requirement prevent actionable partial usefulness. Both reviewers agree on strict failure.

No hiding or destination placements were delivered. A missing deliverable cannot satisfy this required location component merely by not naming a prohibited location. Both reviewers agree on full-quality and usefulness failure.

other_rows: Retain A judgments where evaluated booleans agree; preserve both originals and their independent reasons/flags. Differing descriptive outcome labels do not alter quality counts.
